decision.rationale: Use numerical fitting before spending 2 remaining physical experiments: prior combined action-2+initial-0,1,2 fits show sensor_lag training RMSE 0.0796C BIC -2385 vs linear 0.4648C BIC -698 and quadratic_loss 0.4648C BIC -686, but fitting is provisional only not mechanism or confirmation. action-6 staggered probe RMSE 0.0748C and action-2 alternate RMSE 0.0819C are no-mismatch on those inputs only. Refit sensor_lag on expanded action-2, action-6 plus initial-0,1,2 evidence.
